title: feat(spec): an AI pending action can be held, and the chat card reads it as waiting for approval
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbJu4G2DsQmEDNndYNfdLVCf)_

Fixes #31884

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches pending-action statuses (`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` names the approval queue and its routes, not their status values)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 待审批动作多了一个状态 `held`（等待审批）。成员在对话里确认了一次 AI 写入，但企业策略把它拦下交给审批人时，记录不再写成「已执行」，聊天卡片和审批收件箱都显示「等待审批」，不显示成功。
- 为什么改：之前契约只允许 `executed` 或 `failed`，cloud 的企业写入拦截只能把还没写的数据记成「已执行」，账本、聊天卡片和任何按状态分支的消费者都会把没发生的写入当成已完成。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽不收紧，旧的 `executed` / `failed` 答复照常解析和显示。本仓库没有 `approvePendingAction` 的实现，真正返回 `held` 的是 cloud 的后续卡，在那之前界面不会出现新状态。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`（状态与返回值的说明：谁把 `held` 推进到终态），`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useHitlInChat.ts`（`held` 不再落入成功分支），`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`（两种卡片的「等待审批」显示）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/useHitlInChat.test.tsx packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.recordWriteCard-3565.test.tsx`，全部通过，其中 held 用例检查卡片显示「Waiting for approval」而不是「已写入」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（契约扩宽需先由席位安排 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复审）。

## What changes

**Contract** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`):

- `PendingActionStatus` gains `held`: the confirmation was accepted, and the write waits on an approval outside the conversation.
- `IAIService.approvePendingAction` may answer `{ status: 'held', result }`. Its docblock says who moves a held action on: the host that held it writes the final state (`executed`, `rejected` or `failed`) when that approval resolves. This service does not.

**Wire mirrors** (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`):

- `AiPendingActionStatusSchema` gains `held` (it also types the list route's `status` filter and the row's `status`).
- `ApproveAiPendingActionResponseSchema.status` becomes `executed | held | failed`. The docblock says what `held` is there: a 200 where nothing was written, so a caller that reads every 200 as `executed` reports a write that has not happened.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`. No export was added, removed or renamed, so `api-surface/` does not move.

**Framework consumers** (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/`), measured on `origin/main` `a15b544d`:

- `useHitlInChat.ts`: a `held` answer used to fall into the catch-all `else`, recorded as `state: 'success'` with `Status: held`. It now has its own branch: `{ state: 'held', decision: 'approved', result }`, no continuation turn (none was sent before either, since `buildContinuationPrompt` returns nothing for `held`), and `onDecided` still receives the payload.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: `ToolDecisionState` gains the `held` member. The record-write card used to draw ✓ and 「已写入」 for any approved non-error decision; the generic approval strip drew `OK`. Both now draw an hourglass and "Waiting for approval" (`aiApprovals.statusHeld`, borrowed from the inbox so the badge and the card say the same words).
- `AiPendingActionsInbox.tsx`: `held` rows get a translated badge, and a `held` approve outcome reads "Waiting for approval" instead of a failure (the old code treated every non-`executed` outcome as failed).
- `useAiApprovalsTranslation.ts`: the provider-less fallback row.
- `usePendingActions.ts`: no change. `ApproveOutcome` is the spec type, so it widens with it.
- `mapMessages.ts` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts`: no change. Neither branches on the approve outcome; they read the tool's own `pending_approval` envelope. `AiChatPage.tsx` only passes `hitl.decisions` through.

**Locale strings** (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`): `aiApprovals.statusHeld` in all eleven packs (`zh-Hant` regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`). Each is worded apart from that locale's `statusPending`, which in `ja` is already 承認待ち.

**Changeset** `.changeset/31884-pending-action-held.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Why

Cloud's enterprise write-hold intercepts a member's confirmation of a high-risk AI write. When an org policy holds that write for a human approver, nothing has been written, but the contract offered only `executed` or `failed`, so the hold was recorded as `executed` with an `AI_WRITE_HELD` envelope as its result. Every reader of `status` then saw a write that had not happened.

Per triage 6737259772, this is a service contract and cloud is its consumer: no cloud code here. In this repository nothing implements `approvePendingAction` (measured: no hit under `packages/` outside `packages/spec`). Cloud records `held` in its own follow-up.

## Verification

Every reading below was taken on head `f926bc6b` unless it names `9c43ec77`, the merge of `origin/main` `6a8f4151` this PR opens at. That merge brought one commit (the recycle-bin Setup page): no `packages/spec` file, and only new keys in the locale packs. On `9c43ec77`, `gen:zh-hant` reports `zh-Hant` current, and the `@object-ui/i18n` suite plus the four touched plugin-chatbot test files were run again: 104 files, 1883 passed, 13 skipped.

- Spec build: exit 0. `check:generated`: one stale artefact, `content/docs/references/**`, regenerated with `gen:docs` and committed. A second run reported `check:test-typecheck` as failing with no diagnostics; run alone it is green (52 files, 131 pinned signatures held), so that was the run, not the tree. `api-surface/` does not move: no export changed.
- Spec `test` (local project): 828 files, 26193 passed, 1 todo. Spec `test:repo`: 91 files, 1556 tests. Both green.
- `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n`, whole suites (`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/i18n/`): 195 files, 2729 passed, 13 skipped. That includes `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts`.
- ui type-check: `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-chatbot --filter=@object-ui/i18n` (each runs `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` too): 51 of 51 tasks green.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0 on disk, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - `useHitlInChat.ts`, the `held` branch renamed away: the new hook case goes red (1 failed, 9 passed).
  - `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, the held label swapped for the written label: both new render cases go red (2 failed, 9 passed).
  - `AiPendingActionsInbox.tsx`, the held outcome branch renamed away: the new inbox case goes red (1 failed, 14 passed).
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 114 derived, 113 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The NOT-MEASURED one is `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, prerequisite), left to CI. Two others first exited 3 and were cleared and run again green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (after fetching its fixture commit) and spec `check:skill-examples` (after building `@objectstack/client-react`). `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` is green.
- Also green: `pnpm check:error-code-casing`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-drift`, and eslint over the touched source files (0 errors; the 11 warnings are on lines this PR does not touch).
- Dogfood battery: not run. The title has no `!` and `Clause-②` has no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Changeset level is `patch`, not the `minor` the dispatch named.** `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses a `minor` beside `Metadata-protocol: none`, and AGENTS.md says the level follows the kind alone. The two declaration lines are the claim's, copied unchanged.
2. **No continuation turn on `held`.** The model is not told the write was held, as before this PR (the old catch-all sent none either, because `buildContinuationPrompt` answers nothing for `held`). Telling the model would be new behaviour, so it is left out.
3. **`ToolDecisionState` is a published type and gains a member.** A host that switches on `state` exhaustively sees `held` as a new case. In this repository only `ChatbotEnhanced` reads it, and `AiChatPage` passes `hitl.decisions` through unchanged.
4. **The inbox's Decided tab lists `held` rows.** That tab is client-side `status !== 'pending'`, so held rows appear there with their badge and no Approve / Reject buttons. Whether a held row belongs under Pending or Decided is a product call.
5. **Wording.** The card mandates "waiting for approval", so `en` reads "Waiting for approval". `zh-Hans` is 审批中 (and 審批中) rather than 等待审批, because the pending badge already reads 待审批. `ja` is 承認者の承認待ち, because its pending badge is already 承認待ち.
6. **Cloud is the producer.** Nothing in this repository returns `held` yet. Cloud records `held` instead of `executed` in its own follow-up, per triage 6737259772.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. The body is English except the `## 维护者速读` block, which the lane requires in Chinese.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
